errorTitle: The catalogue could not be shown
errorBody: Something went wrong while loading this page. Please try again.

errors.DUPLICATE_CODE: That code is already used by another record.
errors.DUPLICATE_SKU: That SKU is already used by another variant.
errors.DUPLICATE_BARCODE: That barcode is already used by another variant.
errors.DEFAULT_LIST_PROTECTED: The DEFAULT price list must stay standard, active and open-ended, and keep its code.
errors.OVERLAP: This customer already has this price list for part of that period.
errors.INVALID_STATE: Not possible in the current state (for example, the item is discontinued, already ended, or already in use).
errors.CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: No customer with that number is visible to you.
errors.ATTRIBUTES_INVALID: Write one attribute per line as key=value, with lower-case keys (for example diameter_mm=3.5).

products.title: Products
products.summary: {products, plural, =0 {No products} one {# product} other {# products}} · {variants, plural, =0 {no variants} one {# variant} other {# variants}}

product.newIntro: Add the product first, then its variants (SKUs) and prices.
product.codeHint: 2–40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Stored in capitals.
product.lotTrackedHint: Needed for recalls. Cannot be switched off once stock lots exist.
product.vatNoteNew: VAT is set from the company default (14% until the accountant confirms otherwise).
product.vatNote: VAT: {rate}% (set by finance, not editable here).
product.discontinuedNote: This product is discontinued: it cannot be ordered, but its history, stock lots and past orders are kept.
product.statusHint: Products are never deleted. Discontinue a product to stop selling it.
product.confirmDiscontinue: Discontinue this product? It will no longer be sellable.
product.noPrices: No price list has a price for these variants yet.

variant.title: Variants (SKUs)
variant.empty: No variants yet. Add the first one below.
variant.skuHint: Unique across the catalogue. Stored in capitals.
variant.skuFrozenHint: Cannot change once the variant has stock or orders.
variant.name: Variant name
variant.attributesHint: One per line, as key=value (for example diameter_mm=3.5).
variant.confirmDiscontinue: Discontinue {sku}? It will no longer be sellable.

priceList.listIntro: Prices in EGP, before VAT. Orders are priced on the server when they are saved and submitted.
priceList.codeHint: 2–40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
priceList.name: Name
priceList.kindHint: Customer lists apply only to the customers assigned to them.
priceList.kindFixed: The kind cannot change after creation.
priceList.priorityHint: Lower wins when several lists of the same kind apply.
priceList.validToHint: Leave empty for no end date.
priceList.activeHint: Inactive lists are never used for pricing.
priceList.defaultNote: This is the DEFAULT list used when no other price applies. It always stays active and open-ended.
priceList.resolutionNote: Price used for an order line: the customer's own list first, then a promotional list, then a standard list (lowest priority number first), within the list's dates.

items.title: Prices
items.intro: A new price applies to orders saved or submitted from now on. Orders already submitted keep their price.
items.empty: No prices on this list yet.
items.confirmRemove: Remove the price of {sku} from quantity {qty}?

customers.title: Customers on this list
customers.intro: Only customers you can see are listed. An ended list still applies through its last day.
customers.empty: No customers are assigned to this list.
customers.customerNoHint: As shown on the customer's record.
customers.confirmEnd: End this price list for {customer}? It applies through today.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.intro: Automatic percentage discounts. The best active promotion applies to each order line when the order is saved and submitted.
promotions.name: Name
promotions.discountPctHint: Above 0 and at most 100, up to 2 decimals.
promotions.validToHint: The last day it applies. Leave empty to run until ended.
promotions.targetsHint: Leave every field as “Any” for all products and customers. Filled fields must all match.
promotions.confirmEnd: End “{name}” now? Orders already submitted keep their discount.
promotions.pricingNote: Promotions cannot be edited. To change one, end it and create a new one, so it is always clear which discount applied when.
